summary: frontend-orb preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: frontend-orb@4.4.10 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` bundled in the package. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS blob (single-line hex identifiers, string-array rotator `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9` over a shuffled-alphabet key, large numeric+string constants array) whose contents are not readable without executing under Bun. The advertised purpose of the package is a CircleCI orb aggregating CI commands under `src/`; a Bun-runtime dropper and an opaque Bun-only payload are unrelated to that purpose. The alternate-runtime handoff also causes the payload to execute outside Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
